meow_short.prompt: A single short friendly domestic cat meow, close microphone, clean, no background

meow_taunt.prompt: A sassy drawn-out domestic cat meow, mischievous and cheeky, "mrrreow", close mic, no background noise

meow_annoyed.prompt: An annoyed cat yowl and short hiss, cartoonish, close mic, no background

meow_chirp.prompt: A happy cat chirp and trill, "brrrp", quick, close mic, clean

glass_crash.prompt: A glass window shattering into many pieces, sharp crash with tinkling shards falling on a wooden floor

wood_crash.prompt: Heavy wooden furniture breaking apart, loud splintering crack and thud of planks on a wooden floor

chandelier.prompt: A huge chandelier falls and smashes onto a wooden dining table, metal clanging, glass and crystals shattering, wood breaking

collapse.prompt: Old wooden house roof collapsing, massive timber cracking, beams falling, rumble and dust, cinematic

fire_whoosh.prompt: Fire suddenly igniting with a big whoosh, then crackling flames

thunder.prompt: Distant rolling thunder on a stormy night, deep rumble

witch_cackle.prompt: An old witch cackling wickedly, short theatrical laugh

hiss.prompt: A domestic cat hissing angrily: one sharp breathy defensive hiss with a short spit at the end, close microphone, no background

cat_pounce.prompt: A cat pouncing: a quick scrabble of claws on a wooden floor, a swift leap and a soft thump as it lands, close microphone, no background

cat_jump.prompt: A cat jumping up: a light push-off of paws on a wooden floor and a soft airy whoosh, very short, close microphone, no background
